reviews.text:
I received a damaged MAC foundation order from Nykaa on 3 June. The foundation bottle had leaked completely, and the product was spread all over the packaging. The product cover was torn, and even the outer Nykaa delivery box was ruptured and damaged at the time of delivery.

I immediately raised a return request for the damaged product, which was approved by Nykaa on 10 June. However, despite continuous follow-ups and repeated calls to customer care, the product has still not been picked up as of 26 June.

I have been continuously calling the customer care agents, and every time I am assured that the issue has been marked as “high priority” and that the pickup will happen on the same day. However, no delivery executive ever arrives for pickup. The pickup location is a prime central area, so repeated excuses regarding pickup delays are unacceptable.

Additionally, the tracking status falsely shows that a pickup attempt was made on 20 June at 10:09 PM (at night time). I did not receive any phone call, message, or visit from any delivery executive at that time.

Nykaa has caused unnecessary delay, inconvenience, mental harassment, and extremely poor customer service despite already approving the return request. I request immediate pickup of the damaged product and prompt processing of my refund without any further delay.

“Had a really wonderful experience shopping from Nykaa. The app is very user-friendly and has a huge collection of beauty, skincare, haircare, and fashion products from trusted brands. I found the product descriptions, reviews, and offers very helpful while choosing items. The delivery was quick and the packaging was secure and neatly packed. All the products were genuine and exactly as shown in the app. I also liked the regular discounts, combo offers, and cashback deals which make shopping more affordable. Customer service was also responsive and helpful whenever needed. Overall, it has become one of my favorite online shopping platforms for beauty and fashion products. Highly recommended for anyone looking for authentic products, smooth delivery, and a great shopping experience!”

I am extremely happy with my purchase. The quality of the products is outstanding, and everything arrived in perfect condition with secure packaging. The products are exactly as described and have exceeded my expectations.

After using them, I noticed great results. The texture is smooth, the fragrance is pleasant, and they are gentle on the skin. The prices are reasonable for such amazing quality, making them great value for money.

The delivery was fast, and the overall shopping experience was excellent. I highly recommend these beauty products to anyone looking for reliable, high-quality skincare or makeup. I will definitely purchase again in the future. Thank you for providing such wonderful products and excellent service!
